parameters.name: hcURL
parameters.description: The health check URL of the application. The URL must start with `http://`, and can be up to 255 characters in length. Example: `http://127.0.0.1:8080/_ehc.html`. If this parameter is not specified, the health check URL of the application is not changed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas update-health-check-url --app-id c627c157-560d-43ff-000000000000000 --hc-url http://127.0.0.1:8080/_ehc.html --region cn-hangzhou
